items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him, and I took a trip with him

ctx.x: First thing you know, everybody in the town was playing Charlie Parker's style. And that's the reason why Charlie Parker went into dope heavy. Because every time he turned around and went into a club, he heard himself. Everybody was playing like Charlie Parker. They were all imitating. Sonny Stitt had him down, Jackie McLean was after his ass. Everybody was after the Bird. And the Bird was the Bird. And the Bird was a real nice guy!
